 AFC Champions League Two - Game Week 4 5 Nov 2026 - 03:00 Lion City Sailors host Adelaide United in the AFC Champions League Two, with the Singaporean side looking to build on their commanding position at the top of Group F.
 The Sailors arrive in outstanding form. They have won all five of their last matches across the S.League and continental competition, and they brushed Adelaide aside 2-0 in the reverse fixture just days ago.
 Adelaide United come into this match under pressure. The Australian side have lost three of their last five games, including back-to-back defeats to Lion City Sailors and Perth Glory, and they need a result to keep their qualification hopes alive.
 Sitting second in Group F, Adelaide know a loss could prove decisive in the context of the group. The gap between the two sides in this section tells a clear story about where momentum currently sits.
